categories.title: Thousand Tomes
categories.info: Comprehensive compendium of Valisthean lore, including persons, geography, history, and bestiary. Check in often to acquire new revelations and see how entries evolve with the story.

categories.title: Patron Donation
categories.info: As Clive completes quests and earns Renown, anonymous benefactors will donate money, items, or resources to the cause.

categories.title: Chronolith
categories.info: Within Chronoliths are hidden virtual battlefields, which restrict Clive to the feats and abilities of a single Eikon.

categories.info: Notorious Marks are dangerous fiends terrorizing the countryside. Once a bounty appears on the Hunt Board, the beasts can be encountered in the wild.
